hypotheses.name: Directed/signed topology high-permutation replication with failure-slice diagnostics
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, compared directed/signed kNN topology scores against distance-only cycle baseline under 64-permutation degree-orientation, sign-shuffle, split-label placebo, and metric-matched kNN randomization nulls; added row-level graph-regime diagnostics.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.01169; positive rows 25/36; domain-split Fisher significant 6/6; failure slices: lung/source=-0.00315 and external_lung/source=-0.00440
hypotheses.next_action: Run a biologically weighted failure-slice rescue (STRING/DoRothEA/GO stratification) and test whether source-disjoint negatives become non-negative while preserving global gains.

hypotheses.name: Densified directed path-homology v2 with utility-transfer endpoint
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits at layers {7,11}; built densified directed path-homology scores with kNN sweep (k=8,12), flag-complex Betti-1, and path-length 2/3 directional terms; evaluated discrimination and split-transfer F1 utility against distance-only baseline with directed degree-rewire, sign-shuffle, and random-map transfer controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean edge delta AUROC=+0.00757 (11/12 positive) but mean transfer F1 lift=0.00000 with significant transfer rows 0/12
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this rescue formulation; only revisit path-homology with a materially different utility endpoint (not another discrimination-only or threshold-transfer variant).
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Second consecutive path-homology attempt failed to deliver utility-transfer gains despite directional discrimination improvements.

hypotheses.name: Geodesic neighborhood anisotropy-tail manifold screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}, computed per-node geodesic neighborhood anisotropy-tail scores from local covariance eigenvalue ratios and neighbor-distance tails, aggregated to edges, and compared to geodesic-distance baseline under distance-matched endpoint-swap, neighborhood-permutation, and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.01779; positive rows 25/72; positive domain-split means 3/6 (best external_lung/target=+0.03418, worst immune/source=-0.08534)
hypotheses.next_action: Do not iterate this exact anisotropy-tail endpoint; if revisited, require a materially changed interaction model (e.g., anisotropy x biological support) before spending another full multiseed run.
